lemmas.statement: Top-level target theorem for the Poincare Conjecture through the Perelman proof path.
lemmas.notes: Top-level theorem target node for the replay DAG.

lemmas.statement: Perelman's no-local-collapsing theorem supplies the noncollapsing control required for subsequent canonical-neighborhood and surgery arguments in the three-dimensional Ricci-flow proof path.
lemmas.notes: Replay target for the noncollapsing control layer used downstream in the surgery proof path.

lemmas.statement: Canonical-neighborhood control holds at high-curvature regions under the noncollapsing and curvature assumptions used in the surgery framework.
lemmas.notes: Replay target for the canonical-neighborhood layer derived after noncollapsing control.

lemmas.statement: Ricci flow with surgery can be continued through singular times while preserving the structural estimates required by the proof path.
lemmas.notes: Replay target for continuation through surgery times with required structural estimates preserved.

lemmas.statement: For the simply connected case relevant to Poincare, the surgically modified Ricci-flow solution becomes extinct in finite time.
lemmas.notes: Replay target for the finite-extinction layer in the simply connected three-manifold case.

lemmas.statement: Finite extinction, combined with the preceding Ricci-flow-with-surgery framework, yields the Poincare conclusion for closed simply connected three-manifolds.
lemmas.notes: Replay target for the final deduction of the Poincare conclusion from the preceding verified layers.
